title: show runningconfiguration ntp results in traceback as /etc/ntp.conf is not found
author: dgsudharsan
body:

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
show runningconfig ntp results in traceback. This may be due to ntp moving to ntpsec in bookworm. However the sonic-utilities still checks for /etc/ntp.conf

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/blob/e4df80a5c89c570dfe6580d91ac25c99e425c02d/show/main.py#L1542

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/show", line 8, in <module>
    sys.exit(cli())
             ^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 764, in __call__
    return self.main(*args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 717, in main
    rv = self.invoke(ctx)
         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 1137, in invoke
    return _process_result(sub_ctx.command.invoke(sub_ctx))
                           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 1137, in invoke
    return _process_result(sub_ctx.command.invoke(sub_ctx))
                           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 956, in invoke
    return ctx.invoke(self.callback, **ctx.params)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/click/core.py", line 555, in invoke
    return callback(*args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/show/main.py", line 1539, in ntp
    with open("/etc/ntp.conf") as ntp_file:
         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/etc/ntp.conf'
```
#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. show runningconfig ntp
2.
3.

#### Describe the results you received:
Traceback is observed

#### Describe the results you expected:
No traceback and the command should work

```
202405 branch
```
